beats.text: Picture this: your product just crossed *10,000* weekly users.
beats.visual: HeroStat 10,000 counts up on '10,000', sub 'weekly active users'; Mo cheers; camera pushes in from the wide home shot

beats.text: And for the first time, more people are *staying* than leaving.
beats.visual: HeroStat fades; Mo mood shifts to happy on 'staying'; camera holds, slow drift

beats.text: 90 days ago it was half that — *growth* compounds once a product earns a second visit.
beats.visual: FlipBoard '90 DAYS AGO' on '90'; camera glides toward a skyline; District towers start rising on 'growth', each block one cohort

beats.text: Every new cohort adds another block to the skyline.
beats.visual: District keeps rising; MapLabel 'COHORT GROWTH' pins above the tallest tower on 'skyline'

beats.text: The next milestone: *50,000* users, by the sprint that ships referrals.
beats.visual: HeroStat 50,000 counts up on '50,000', sub 'next milestone'; FlipBoard 'SHIPS REFERRALS' underneath; camera pulls back to the wide shot

beats.text: Every growth story can take this shape — *yours* starts with the first number worth bragging about.
beats.visual: wide hold on the whole skyline + both stats' afterglow; Mo waves; Disclaimer 'Placeholder numbers — swap in your own data.' stays on screen throughout
